text: Assumption: The structure is primarily populated by the application as a value object and passed to ara::diag interfaces in order to be serialized to external clients upon SOVD bulk transfer requests — is this correct?

assumption: The structure is primarily populated by the application as a value object and passed to ara::diag interfaces in order to be serialized to external clients upon SOVD bulk transfer requests.
rationale: The SWS payload specifies the data structure and its members, but not the concrete serialization method in the SOVD transport protocol.
